mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a restrictive monetary policy coupled with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and UNRATE MoM < -0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 5% year-over-year signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where RSAFS YoY > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals accommodative monetary policy with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.
